AllowedHosts.title: Allowed sites
AllowedHosts.description: Chrome match patterns of the sites the extension is allowed to run on.

BlockedHosts.title: Blocked sites
BlockedHosts.description: Chrome match patterns of the sites the extension must never run on.

FeatureFlags.description: Features the administrator turns on or off.

KillSwitch.description: Turns the extension off without uninstalling it.
